svg.title: B4 POWER top view
svg.text: FRONT EDGE: jacks face the glands (box front wall)
B4 POWER: top view, 1:1 at 9 px/mm, SolderFul SOLDERBREAD#02 81.3 x 50.8 mm
solid line: jumper or wire on top
ring + tick: lead to another board or off the stack
diamond: pad with a soldered lead
gold dashed circle: M3 standoff (hex corners)
grey dashed box: plug or lead keep-out
to U1 SYS: EVM SYS to S7V8F3 VIN
to PG1 L+: pack + (pigtail) to the shunt, soldered;
to PG1 L+: gauge sense, own wire from the pigtail ta
to U1 BAT: shunt to EVM BAT (22 AWG minimum)
